about: How the SwitchDriver drives THIS console. Calibrated in WP-00 (2026-10-25); used by tools/spike/wp00-loop.sh, then by WP-03's driver. Host, port and token come from .env.

screenCheck.how: crop the screenshot to the region, compare with the reference PNG: ImageMagick 'compare -metric RMSE'; normalized value below the threshold = same screen

home-first-tile.screen: HOME menu, cursor on the first tile (Spelunky 2), nothing running (no 'Playing' badge)

user-picker.screen: 'Who is using the software?' after A on the tile

hbmenu-header.screen: hbmenu, any mode ('hbmenu v3.6.1 / nx-hbloader v2.4.5')

hbmenu-applet-badge.screen: hbmenu opened from the Album: red 'Applet Mode' badge. Must NOT match in application mode

close-dialog.screen: HOME menu after X: 'Close the software you are currently using?' (Close preselected)

software-closed.screen: after the app ended with svcExitProcess (watchdog, a crash before the handler is set up): 'The software was closed because an error occurred.' with one OK button (WP-03c)

demo-pokedex.screen: borealis demo, Pokedex tab open (Bulbasaur, Charmander rows)

references.files: tests/e2e/device/local/<name>.png (git-ignored). To recreate: take a screenshot of the described screen and crop the region.

toHbmenuApplicationMode.ifNot: closeSoftware, then expect again; still not: stop and ask the owner

toHbmenuApplicationMode.note: Spelunky 2 always asks; the first user is preselected
about 3.7 s after the second A

notes: -p is relative to sdmc:/switch/ (hbmenu prepends it): -p suwayomi-nx/suwayomi-nx.nro -> sdmc:/switch/suwayomi-nx/suwayomi-nx.nro. A leading /switch/ gives 'open: err=2'.
hbmenu writes the received .nro to that path in place (not atomic), then starts it. Without -p: sdmc:/switch/<file name>.
4.5 MB borealis demo: 0.9 s to send (zlib), on screen about 2 s after nxlink starts.

launchFromHbmenuList: fallback only: the entry's position depends on what else is in sdmc:/switch/. RIGHT x N then A; demo on screen 1.2 s after A

closeSoftware.note: the running title is the first tile, cursor on it, marked 'Playing'
never press A without this check: on a normal HOME screen A starts a game

softwareClosedDialog.found: WP-03c, 2026-10-26: an application process that ends with svcExitProcess (no proper exit through libnx's appletExit) gets this dialog from the HOME menu. No crash report, no fatal: harmless

steps.note: an A while it fades in gets lost

steps.ifNot: expect software-closed again, then A again (3 tries)

steps.note: selects the Album icon (first tap selects)

toHbmenuAppletMode.leave: HOME (PLUS does nothing in hbmenu). Back on HOME the cursor is on the first tile again

screenshots: retry on failure: during an app switch /screenshot answers HTTP 500 {"error":"capture failed","rc":"0xe0ce"}. Accept only HTTP 200 + JPEG magic FF D8
virtualController: works in HOME, hbmenu and the borealis demo with the Joy-Cons attached (handheld). Joy-Cons detached: see STATUS / WP-00
